thread:
carmen (Design): quick microcopy check for the "Pin model to route" confirmation modal. Current heading is `Pin model?` and body says `This model will be pinned to the route.` Users asked what pinning means for rollouts, traffic, and automatic updates. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/pin-modal.png :pushpin:

ev an (Product): in user tests people weren't sure whether pinning prevents rollbacks or automatic upgrades — we should call out that pinning opts the route out of automatic rollouts and requires manual unpin to resume. also avoid scary words like "lock" if the action is reversible.

min (Eng): backend: pinning sets an override on the route. It prevents scheduled rollouts and auto-updates; it does not stop manual deploys to the route. Billing and traffic routing are unaffected. Technical note: there is an audit entry and activity feed entry when pin/unpin occur.

carmen (Design): proposed compact copy options (aim: short + explicit consequences):
1) "Pin model to route 51200000000— prevents automatic rollouts. To resume auto-updates, unpin the route.
   [Cancel] [Pin model]"
2) "Pin this model 12— this route will stay on the selected model and won't receive automatic upgrades. You can unpin later.
   [Back] [Pin]"
3) "Keep this route on model v3.2 12— stops scheduled rollouts and auto-updates. Manual deploys allowed.
   [Cancel] [Pin model]"
Which reads clearest and scannable? I'm leaning toward a single-line heading with a short consequence sentence for screen readers expanded.

julie (QA): prefer option 3 because it names the model and clarifies manual deploys are allowed. Tests to add: audit feed entry, ensure activity shows "pinned by <user>", keyboard focus into modal on open, and screen reader reads expanded detail. Also test concurrent unpin/rollout race.

ev an (Product): wording nit: avoid punctuation that feels technical (like parentheses). Make the primary CTA explicit: use `Pin model` not `Pin`. Also consider adding a subtle inline link "What does pinning do?" to docs.

min (Eng): agree on `Pin model` CTA. Also we should surface that pinning may affect feature flags or AB tests tied to model versions — link to more details rather than bloating modal.

carmen (Design): updated compact copy for the modal: `Pin model v3.2 to this route 12— this route won't receive automatic rollouts or scheduled upgrades. Manual deploys are still allowed.` Buttons: `Cancel` and `Pin model` (primary). Add a hidden `aria-describedby` with: "Pinning creates a route override. An audit entry is created. To resume automatic rollouts, unpin the route. See docs for interactions with A/B tests."

julie (QA): add PR test checklist: 1) verify audit + activity feed entries, 2) screen reader reads hidden description, 3) keyboard focus management, 4) telemetry event records whether user followed the docs link.

ops-bot: branch "pin-model-copy-clarity" created -> PR #1228

carmen (Design): great 12— i'll update the PR with the final copy, a11y notes, and a screenshot. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
